description: TX2 federal revenue and budget statutes and regulations, admitted from the prepared source inventory; two annual fiscal-year instruments stay explicitly deferred pending reviewer direction on temporal-model treatment, and one is held out for a structural parsing difficulty.
notes: Normalized from prompts/cluster-2-batches/lex-mex-cl2-batch-TX2.json for the repository Rust ingestion gate.
All four prepared NEW entries were absent from adapters, corpus/mx, and existing operational batch manifests when this manifest was created.

The prepared manifest's dof_publication/dof_last_reform fields are provenance context, not part of the operational batch-manifest schema, and are dropped here rather than smuggled in as unknown properties.
A live recheck of all four source_pdf URLs on 2026-08-01 returned HTTP 200 for each.

lif-2026 and pef-2026 stay explicitly blocked per the prepared source: both are annual fiscal-year instruments that expire with FY2026, and their temporal-model treatment needs reviewer confirmation before fetch. Already carried as explicit deferrals in docs/project-status.md.

lcmopfih is held out per the ingestion-difficulty-log.md hold-out-and-flag policy (nested-law-in-enacting-article): its source PDF enacts an entire distinct law verbatim inside one article of an unrelated 1990 instrument that is itself formally titled and enacted as a Ley despite being materially a reform decree, and the parser currently captures only that wrapper article rather than the nested law's real 15 articles plus its own closing transitorios (distinct from the enclosing instrument's own, separate closing transitorios). See docs/ingestion-difficulty-log.md for the full report.
Instrument order is preserved from the prepared cluster-2 plan.
